name: LangChain
description: Techlio builds production AI agents and retrieval systems with LangChain and LangGraph, with evaluation, guardrails and tracing built in.
h1: LangChain agents and RAG systems *that hold up in production.*
answer: LangChain is an open-source framework for building applications on language models, and LangGraph extends it for multi-step agents with state. Techlio uses them to build retrieval systems and agents that are evaluated against real cases, traced end to end, and limited to approved tools.

builds.title: Retrieval-augmented generation
builds.text: Search over your documents and data that returns answers with their sources, respecting who is allowed to see what.

builds.title: Multi-step agents
builds.text: LangGraph agents that plan, call tools, pause for human approval and resume, with every step logged.

builds.title: Evaluation and tracing
builds.text: An eval set from your own cases and tracing on every request, so quality and cost are measured, not guessed.

fits: The system needs several steps, tools or data sources, not a single prompt
You want to switch or compare models without a rewrite
You need traces and evaluations to satisfy a security or quality review

faqs.question: Do we need LangChain at all?
faqs.answer: Not always. For a single prompt or a simple workflow, direct API calls are easier to maintain. We recommend the framework only where its structure earns its keep.

faqs.question: Can you improve an existing LangChain app?
faqs.answer: Yes. The usual gains come from better retrieval, an eval set, and tighter tool permissions.

faqs.question: Which vector stores do you use?
faqs.answer: Commonly pgvector, because it keeps vectors beside your existing Postgres data. We use others when scale or features call for it.
